media.caption: Skill cooldowns on a movable timeline.
Track window — toggle skills, debuffs and buffs, with filter and search.

changed: Less stutter in combat. The bar used to re-read your buff and cooldown state on every single frame — and kept doing it even while hidden — which showed up as micro-stutter in busy fights. It now refreshes on a fixed schedule, and only while it is actually on screen. The bar looks and behaves exactly the same: timers and sweeps still animate every frame.
Hiding the bar now costs nothing. Its tracking goes fully idle instead of working away in the background.
